epic.title: RuVector/Decomposition Swarm Corrective Implementation - Iteration 3
epic.description: Corrective epic to address Loop 2 validation gaps (0.60 consensus). Resolves test framework execution issues, security remediation, and performance benchmarking.
goals: Resolve RuVector native module loading in WSL2 (critical blocker)
Execute full test suite and capture results
Verify SLA enforcement with real measurements

phases.name: Test Environment Setup & Module Resolution
phases.description: Resolve RuVector native module loading issue that prevents test execution in WSL2 environment.
success_criteria: Basic sanity test passes (insert, retrieve, query)
All 6 test files are discoverable and compilable

tasks.name: Investigate RuVector WSL2 Compatibility
tasks.description: Root cause analysis of native module loading failure. Determine platform detection issue or missing dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Identified root cause of native module failure
Documented all platform detection checks in RuVector

tasks.name: Implement Module Resolution Workaround
tasks.description: Apply workaround: force rebuild from source, use WASM fallback, or Docker-based execution.

tasks.name: Validate Test Infrastructure
tasks.description: Verify Jest configuration, TypeScript compilation, and test file discovery.

phases.name: Test Execution & Results Capture
phases.description: Execute full RuVector and SLA test suites, capture results, identify any failures.
success_criteria: 92 RuVector tests executed (insert, query, collections, integration, benchmarks, sanity)
All test results logged to artifacts directory
SLA enforcement tests pass (1 file, 173 LOC)

tasks.name: Execute RuVector Test Suite
tasks.description: Run all 6 RuVector test files with coverage measurement. Capture timings, memory usage, and any failures.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test:ruvector completes without errors
All 92 test cases report pass/fail status
Performance benchmarks execute and show metrics

tasks.name: Execute SLA Enforcement Tests
tasks.description: Run Phase 6 SLA test file. Verify SLA definitions and enforcement logic.
acceptance_criteria: SLA test file (173 LOC) passes all assertions

tasks.name: Capture & Analyze Test Results
tasks.description: Generate comprehensive test report with pass/fail breakdown, performance metrics, and gap analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Identified any test failures and root causes

phases.name: Security Remediation (Tier 1)
phases.description: Fix 8 high-severity vulnerabilities (Tier 1 critical fixes identified in Loop 2 validation).

tasks.name: Implement Encryption for Backups

acceptance_criteria: All user inputs validated (type, size, format)

tasks.name: Verify Security Audit Results
tasks.description: Run comprehensive security audit. Ensure no critical/high vulnerabilities remain.
acceptance_criteria: Code review for injection/XSS/auth bypass: 0 found

tasks.name: Measure Phase-Specific SLA Targets
tasks.description: For each of 7 phases, measure: execution time, memory usage, decomposition quality, validator overhead.

notes.loop_2_validator_findings_reconciliation: Loop 2 validators reported 210+ RuVector tests missing, but 92 tests with 2660 LOC were found and designed. Similarly, SLA tests were reported as 15 separate tests but only 1 test file exists (173 LOC). Validators may have miscounted or expected different test organization. This corrective epic executes the actual test suite as designed.
notes.test_blocking_issue: RuVector native module fails to load in WSL2 environment. Tests are fully designed (92 cases, 2660 LOC) but cannot execute until module resolution is fixed. This is the primary blocker preventing Loop 2 closure.
notes.security_remediation_path: Loop 2 security validator identified 8 high-severity + 2 critical issues. All are addressed in Phase 3 of this epic with 8-hour estimation. After fixes, security score should improve from 0.78 to 0.95+.
notes.performance_baseline_gap: Loop 2 found no production benchmarks captured. Phase 4 of this epic establishes baselines for all 6 phases, enabling future performance monitoring and regression detection.
notes.next_step_after_acceptance: Once this epic is accepted, immediately start Phase 1 to resolve RuVector module loading. This is the critical path item.
